_about: What the race cameras see, placed from the layout data (tools/course/newmarket/to_race_view.py). pieces: [model, piece, x, z, turn (degrees, anticlockwise from above; 0 = the piece's front facing +z), stretch along its front, scale]; boxes: {colour: [[x, z, length, depth, y from, y to, yaw]]}; flats: paving and gravel; banks: rows of points across a grassy bank [x, y, z, ...] (y above the ground); trees [x, z, tree, scale, turn, 1 if in a belt (an understorey under its crown), 2 for scrub (a light crown only), metres up or down from the ground]; boards [x, z, turn, design]; people: [x, y, z, facing] flattened.
